title: Discoidin Domain Receptor 2 Is Required for Tooth Extraction Socket Healing
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1633-1642, November 2026.
Discoidin Domain Receptor 2 (DDR2) is a collagen-activated tyrosine kinase required for bone and tooth development as well as regeneration of calvarial and long bones. Although DDR2 is expressed in alveolar bone, its functions in this site have not been ...
